response.overview: The documentary takes us on a journey through the world of fanzines across Europe, exploring artistic practices that have become a shared and unifying language, outside of institutional and commercial circuits. Across the continent, underground scenes are flourishing—inventive worlds where people are active and creative, and where artists follow only one rule: “Do it yourself!” The essence of the underground lies in movement, connection, and spontaneity. Nothing is truly organized—or, if it is, only at the last minute. A journey through different territories, guided by people’s desires and their creations.
response.title: UnderGronde
